visualCharacteristics.purpose: testimonial slider: optional intro heading beside a carousel of quote cards (author name/role, optional photo, quote) with prev/next arrows and dot indicators

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with a single cell containing the intro heading/text; then one row per testimonial: cell 1 = author (optional photo, name, role), cell 2 = quote. A single-cell row is a quote only. One testimonial renders without controls

usage: Customer or employee testimonials on resource, landing and corporate pages. Use `photo` when author photos are present.
reuseGuidance: Use for quote/testimonial rotators. For image hero slideshows use a plain carousel.
